platforms.name: RouteNote Free Premium Distribution Publishing Upload Route
platforms.country: United Kingdom / worldwide digital music distribution and publishing platform
platforms.feeAmount: Free-first manual route with optional Premium/payment boundary. Official page says artists can choose FREE or Premium service, change payment model any time, and distribute to major platforms.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Owner review required for account/signup, release upload, metadata, artwork/audio ownership, platform selection, free-versus-Premium revenue-share decision, publishing/Content ID terms and payout setup. No account was created, no release was uploaded and no payment model was selected.
platforms.notes: Official RouteNote page describes worldwide distribution to Spotify, Apple Music and more, Free/Premium plans, over-50-platform partner coverage, monthly earnings/statistics and independent-artist sessions. Suitable for MarcsMusic distribution/publishing review, but owner approval is required before any upload or revenue-share decision.

platforms.name: Record Union Distribution Royalty Split EPK Playlist Pitch Route
platforms.country: Sweden / worldwide digital music distribution platform
platforms.feeAmount: Paid release route. Official page says users can join free but lists annual release pricing from $14/year for Top Dog and $19/year for World Domination, plus possible UPC fee.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Owner review required for account/signup, paid release tier, UPC decision, track upload, collaborators/royalty splits, EPK data, playlist-pitch priority upgrade, Content ID upgrade and copyright/label metadata. No account was created, no UPC was bought and no release was started.
platforms.notes: Official Record Union page exposes Get started / Start releasing routes, distribution to 20+ services including Spotify, Apple Music, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Music, TIDAL, Amazon, Deezer, Beatport and SoundCloud, plus royalty splits, Linkfire smart links, EPK, Spotify for Artists and optional professional upgrades.

platforms.name: iMusician Global Distribution Editorial Playlist Pitching Route
platforms.country: Switzerland / Europe / worldwide artist and label distribution platform
platforms.feeAmount: Paid / subscription-manual route. Official page exposes Pricing, Sign Up, Digital Music Distribution, Editorial Playlist Pitching, Music Promotion, YouTube Monetization and Mastering services.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Owner review required for account/signup, pricing plan, release upload, platform delivery, editorial playlist pitch, promotion services, YouTube monetization, mastering, ownership terms and multilingual support workflow. No account was created, no pitch was filed and no paid service was activated.
platforms.notes: Official iMusician page says artists can reach global audiences on 200+ platforms, keep 100% ownership, use distribution, Artist Hub, analytics, mastering, YouTube monetization, promotion and editorial playlist pitching to Spotify, Apple Music, Beatport and other platforms.

platforms.name: TuneCore Digital Distribution Publishing Accelerator Upload Route
platforms.country: United States / global independent music distribution and publishing platform
platforms.feeAmount: Paid subscription/manual route. Official page says unlimited releases start at $24.99/year and distribution reaches 150+ stores/services.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Owner review required for account/signup, subscription plan, release upload, store selection, artwork, splits, publishing administration, Accelerator eligibility, royalty advance terms and rights/copyright declarations. No account was created, no subscription was purchased and no release was uploaded.
platforms.notes: Official TuneCore page exposes Sell Your Music, Pricing, Login/Sign Up/Dashboard routes, says artists can distribute to Spotify, Apple Music, TikTok, YouTube, Tidal, Tencent and 150+ stores, keep ownership, use publishing administration, splits, artist services and Accelerator discovery tools.

platforms.name: AWAL Select Artist Submit Your Music Distribution Synch Route
platforms.country: United Kingdom / United States / global selective artist services and distribution platform
platforms.feeAmount: Selective free application/manual route; no public upfront submission fee observed on the official page. Commercial terms require owner review if AWAL accepts/contacts the artist.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Owner review required for AWAL's selective application route, artist/release data, streaming/social metrics, rights/ownership declarations, possible commercial terms, playlisting, synch/licensing, radio promotion and funding discussions. No application was opened or submitted and no login/session was used.
platforms.notes: Official AWAL page exposes LOG IN and SUBMIT YOUR MUSIC / Join Us application routes, says AWAL supports independent artists with ownership, visibility, global release planning, worldwide playlisting, artist marketing, funding, creative support, radio promotion, synch/licensing and digital/physical distribution; the page says AWAL only partners with a select group of artists and shows 2026 activity/news.
